name: ufe_bot_inase
title: Mecanim Bot's normals (UFE 2) - Inase's own strikes
note: a08's own strikes (user 10-05: "inase用mecanim bot的动作", picked from out/a08_ufe_normals.mp4, every standing normal of UFE 2's demo characters on her). Mecanim Bot has six standing normals and the fight four buttons: A light punch (jab), B medium kick (mid front kick), C heavy punch (lunging straight), D heavy kick (roundhouse high kick) - her light kick is left out (its clip is 0.125 s at the move set's speed and its frame count does not fit the clip; it reached 0.39 m on Inase), the medium punch (uppercut) too. Speeds and active frames ("hit") as UFE's move set _2DFighter/Mecanim_Bot has them (ufe_normals.json); no knockdown (UFE gives these none). Her stance and walks stay the fight's motion pack's (F3), as in the video she was picked from.
source: Universal Fighting Engine 2 v2.7.0a (Asset Store), the demo characters' standing normals and command normals as their move sets have them (_3DFighter/Robot_Kyle, _3DFighter/Ethan_Stance_1, _2DFighter/Mecanim_Bot, _2DFighter/Mike; speeds, levels and launchers from _work/ufe2/ufe_moves.tsv; "hit" = the move's active frames as clip seconds: UFE frames are 60 a second after the speed, so frame f is f x speed / 60 s of the clip - Bot's light kick is the one move whose frame count does not fit its clip). Who / zh / ufe / ufeFrames are notes for people and the videos (the importer reads the rest). Mike's light and heavy attacks are the same motion data as Kyle's (README) - only his medium ones are here. Ellen's are 2D sprite animations. Crouching and jumping normals, throws and specials are left out: the fight has no crouch, jump or throw
